A_background_cap_exchange.meaning: two identical static regular caps are exchanged by R

B_fixed_support_orbifold_parity.meaning: the frozen gluing map has fixed set Sigma at y=0

C_moving_covariant_reflection.meaning: R_zeta:y-zeta(x)->-[y-zeta(x)] is an x-dependent change of the fixed-set/gluing datum

Z2_notions.composite_support: sigma_hat can determine a moving center only after the additional v6.14 center-manifold domain identification is adopted
Z2_notions.homogeneous_family: rho_J(q) labels separately solved doubled backgrounds; it does not promote R to an x-dependent varied reflection

diffeomorphisms.cap_exchanging: composition of an allowed map with the fixed R
diffeomorphisms.cap_preserving: piecewise diffeomorphisms related by R and preserving pole regularity
diffeomorphisms.forbidden_current_domain: independent changes of the two pole-to-junction domains or of R

gauge_choices.B_zero: may be imposed locally only with compensating E/zeta data; it cannot change the invariant S_Sigma
gauge_choices.all_three_zero: possible only when S_Sigma was already zero or after an extra domain restriction
gauge_choices.zeta_zero: already fixed in Case I; not a removal of S_Sigma

diffeomorphisms.gluing_preserving: xi^y odd and continuous, hence xi^y|Sigma=0; xi tangential and even
diffeomorphisms.interface_moving: xi^y|Sigma!=0 changes the declared fixed set unless the embedding/reflection map is added to the domain

endpoint_displacement.single_moving_center: one zeta(x) in y-zeta(x) changes the reflection map and is not the stored copywise homogeneous cap-length variation

extrinsic_curvature.trace: K reverses with the chosen normal

orientation.lapse: N_-(rho)=N_+(rho); N is positive and reflection even
orientation.stored_cap_coordinates: rho_+,rho_- in [0,rho_J], each increasing from its regular pole toward the common junction

parity.derivation: R has Jacobian diag(-1,1,1,1,1); every covariant y index contributes one minus sign in R^*g

gauge_invariants.S_Sigma_outward: equal on the two copied caps
gauge_invariants.delta_sigma_Sigma: odd (and zero in the stored Dirichlet domain)

gauge_parameters.xi^y: odd for a continuous fixed-gluing diffeomorphism

scalar.pure_radial_gauge_perturbation: -sigma_0' xi^y is odd because sigma_0' is even and xi^y is odd
scalar.sigma_hat: odd on every fixed (tau,s) center sheet
scalar.unrestricted_cover_perturbation: decomposes into even and odd sectors; background parity alone does not silently admit the even sector

provenance.item: tensor pullback and oriented-boundary symplectic formulas
provisional B1 and exact metric matcher
Z2 threading parity and source parity
constraint Green operator after a domain theorem

regularity.K_and_Q: finite one-sided traces with the B1-supported jump
regularity.N: reflection-even one-sided traces; positive lapse may be continuous
regularity.N_mu_and_B: one-sided multiplier traces obey reflection parity; neither the induced-metric matcher nor the stored action establishes their signed-coordinate continuity
regularity.geometry_class: piecewise C^2 bulk metric with continuous induced metric and an intentional one-sided first-normal-derivative jump at Sigma
regularity.h_mu_nu: continuous trace; piecewise C^2; normal derivative may jump
regularity.normal_E: one-sided odd relation; a jump is allowed
regularity.normal_sigma: common-normal derivative even; outward derivatives opposite
regularity.odd_trace_rule: odd parity implies a zero fixed-set value only after continuity of that field is established
regularity.psi_and_E: continuous as induced-metric scalars; piecewise C^2
regularity.sigma: continuous odd Dirichlet trace sigma_Sigma=0; piecewise C^2
